The '''Imperial Zoological Agency''' was a branch of the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]],<ref name="CSWE agency" /> a part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CSWE SurveyCorps">{{CSWECite|II|97|Imperial Survey Corps (ISC)}}</ref> The duties of the Imperial Zoological Agency included the cataloging of [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and creatures on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] newly discovered by the Empire.<ref name="CSWE agency" /> One such locale was the planet [[Najarka]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Najarka system/Legends|Najarka system]]</ref> [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]]. There, [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the agency<ref name="Abduction" /> discovered<ref name="CSWE Kichicolia">{{CSWECite|II|216|kichicolia}}</ref> and cataloged the [[kichicolia]],<ref name="Abduction" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="CSWE Kichicolia" /> of [[Color/Legends|white]]-and-black-[[Hair/Legends|furred]] [[Tree/Legends|arboreal]] [[Primate/Legends|primate]] inhabiting the planet's equatorial belt of [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]].<ref name="Abduction" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Zoological Agency was introduced in ''[[The Abduction]]'', a [[1992]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[Chuck Truett]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Abduction" />
